description.summary: how many workspaces there are, and which one is showing

protocol.description: Trindle has one row of numbered workspaces, shared by every screen. This tells a program how long the row is and which workspace is showing, and lets it ask to go to another. Offered only to programs the compositor trusts with the window list.

interface.name: trindle_workspaces_manager_v1
interface.description: The row is announced when this is bound, and again whenever its length or the workspace showing changes. Workspaces have no names: the first is number 1 and is index 0.

description.summary: no more news of the row is wanted

request.name: go
request.description: Does nothing if there is no workspace at that index. The compositor answers with a new "row" once it has gone there.

arg.name: index
arg.summary: the workspace to show, counting from 0

event.name: row
event.description: Always sent whole, so a program never has to put pieces together.

arg.name: showing
arg.summary: the index of the one showing
